question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

He is going to ________ the campaign against excessive use of ________ in local production units.
solution:
The correct answer is: **lead.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lead"** means to guide or direct a group or initiative, often taking responsibility for its success or direction. (नेतृत्व करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She was chosen to lead the research team due to her expertise in the field.
 
 
 
• The word** "lead"** also refers to a soft, heavy grey metal (लेड).
 
 
• **Example**: Lead is used in pipes, roofs, etc.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that he will spearhead the campaign opposing the overuse of lead in local manufacturing facilities.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Combat** (लड़ाई करना): To fight or struggle against something.

 
 
• **Example:** Governments are working together to combat climate change.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Spice** (मसाला): A substance used to flavor food, often aromatic or pungent.
 
 
• **Example:** She added some spice to the dish to enhance its flavor.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Protest** (विरोध करना): To express strong disapproval or objection.
 
 
• **Example:** The workers organized a protest against unfair wages.
